agent_note: Third-person past-tense narration throughout, close free indirect discourse over several characters (Olive, Jack, Bob, Cindy, Kayley). 26 event quotes, all past, no present event-narration anywhere. Quotation marks survive on roughly half the dialogue; where absent I used vocatives, direct address, filled pauses and self-repair rather than the tag rule, and recorded the signal per quote. Two abstentions (q03626, q03658) are both short unmarked first-person/present fragments that could be speech or free indirect thought; neither would plausibly be third-person present narration, so the past reading is not fragile. Gnomic held to present-tense universals only (q03637, q03643); several past-tense generalizing passages (q03621, q03627, q03640, q03657) were kept as event/past per the methodology's load-bearing rule.
